pr_title: Disable UI rendering when history is skipped
pr_body:
When we are scrolling, resizing, or moving elements, we already disable the history. Since those actions do not change the state of the UI, we can also avoid re-drawing it and save ~10ms per frame.

I had to change all the forceUpdate() to setState({}), otherwise it would bypass shouldComponentUpdate.

Fixes #558

issue_context.title: Decouple UI and canvas
issue_context.body:
Right now, whenever we drag, we call setState() which calls render() on the App component which re-renders the UI and on componentDidUpdate updates the canvas.

This is wasteful because the UI doesn't change and we're triggering the entire re-render. Especially now that we are displaying a sizable UI.

We should move all the UI in its own component and shield it under memoized / PureComponent / shouldComponentUpdate.
